leads.title: Low-dose gastrointestinal radiation for feline small-cell lymphoma
leads.identity_comparison: IACUC 8528. Three consecutive daily fractions totaling 6 Gy to the entire GI tract under anesthesia, with stool sampling and rechecks at 1 week, 1, 3 and 6 months. Named investigator Tiffany Martin, DVM. Distinct from Texas A&M 358215 (different center, eligibility and fractionation), Missouri high-grade GI lymphoma WART+COP/doxorubicin, and Tufts inflammatory-enteropathy RT (excludes GI lymphoma).
leads.reason: Official native state Active - Recruiting; individual rendered protocol accepts screening, states recruitment from 2026-11-02. One named site CSU VHEC, 300 W Drake Rd, Fort Collins, Colorado. After enrollment the study covers radiation, stool testing and protocol recheck appointments. Owners pay other diagnostic and treatment-related costs; do not infer separate anesthesia or travel coverage.
